# Repository template

<!-- Generated by .darkfactory/github/scripts/generate_documents.py; edit source records instead. -->


## Overview

This repository is a technology-neutral starting point for projects coordinated by human contributors and AI coding agents. It supplies source-controlled product intent, architectural decisions, agent operating rules, reusable roles and procedures, and a minimal GitHub delivery pipeline. **It is a template, not an implemented application.**

The public README is an overview of the repository and onboarding process, **not** the product requirements document. Requirements are authored in `.darkfactory/agents/requests/` and compiled into `.darkfactory/agents/PRD.md`; architecture is authored in `.darkfactory/agents/decisions/` and compiled into `.darkfactory/agents/ARCHITECTURE.md`.

### Getting started

1. Replace the starter goal in `.darkfactory/agents/GOAL.md` with a specific outcome and measurable acceptance criteria.
2. Add an approved request to `.darkfactory/agents/requests/` and accepted architectural choices to `.darkfactory/agents/decisions/`.
3. Adjust `.darkfactory/agents/rules/` for project-specific conventions, then select the relevant role and skill instructions.
4. Regenerate committed docs: `python3 .darkfactory/github/scripts/generate_documents.py --write`.
5. Verify: `python3 .darkfactory/github/scripts/generate_documents.py --check`, then the project's own build/test commands when an application exists.

_Source: [0001-overview.md](notes/0001-overview.md)_


## Repository layout

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `.darkfactory/agents/GOAL.md` | Human-authored purpose and success criteria |
| `.darkfactory/agents/PRD.md` | Generated approved product requirements |
| `.darkfactory/agents/ARCHITECTURE.md` | Generated accepted architecture decisions |
| `.darkfactory/agents/AGENTS.md` | Generated active operating rules (also root `CONTRIBUTING.md`) |
| `.darkfactory/agents/README.md` | Generated public overview (also root `README.md`) |
| `.darkfactory/agents/PLAN.md` | Human-authored near-term plan and verification gates |
| `.darkfactory/agents/TODO.md` | Human-authored actionable worklist; not published in README |
| `.darkfactory/agents/SCRATCHPAD.md` | Non-normative temporary notes |
| `.darkfactory/agents/notes/` | Published README sections and supplemental project notes |
| `.darkfactory/agents/requests/` | Independently reviewable requirement records |
| `.darkfactory/agents/decisions/` | Independently reviewable architecture decisions |
| `.darkfactory/agents/rules/` | Independently reviewable mandatory rules |
| `.darkfactory/agents/agents/` | Portable agent role descriptions |
| `.darkfactory/agents/skills/` | Portable task procedures (`<name>/SKILL.md`) |
| `.darkfactory/github/` | GitHub workflow definitions and repository-management scripts |
| `.darkfactory/tests/` | The sole canonical directory for all tests, fixtures and test support |
| `.agents` | Root Git symlink to `.darkfactory/agents` |
| `.github` | Root Git symlink to `.darkfactory/github`; GitHub Actions does not reliably discover workflows through this alias |
| `repo.dfconfig` | DarkFactory repository declaration and GitHub protection policy |
| `VERSION` | Canonical SemVer without a leading `v` |
| `LICENSE` | GPL-3.0 license text |

Canonical files live under `.darkfactory/`; the root `.agents` and `.github` paths are Git symlinks. Edit source records, never their generated projections. GitHub may not execute workflows when `.github` is a symlink; validate the actual Actions registry before relying on CI, version bumps or automatic releases.

_Source: [0002-layout.md](notes/0002-layout.md)_


## Contribution and delivery

Use `development` as the integration branch. Work in a focused topic branch and propose the change into `development`. After review and verification, publish `development` into `main` using a release pull request.

The versioning, document-check and release workflows are stored under `.darkfactory/github/workflows/`, reached locally through the `.github` symlink. **GitHub Actions may not discover these symlinked workflows.** Treat automatic version bumps, PR checks and releases as unavailable until the GitHub Actions registry and actual trigger behavior have been verified. Native branch protection also requires separate administrative activation. Do not claim enforcement or automation without live evidence.

Useful command:

```bash
python3 .darkfactory/github/scripts/generate_documents.py --write
python3 .darkfactory/github/scripts/generate_documents.py --check
python3 -m unittest discover -s .darkfactory/tests -p 'test_*.py'
```

For task-specific guidance, select a role from `.darkfactory/agents/agents/` and skills from `.darkfactory/agents/skills/`. Treat them as portable instructions: a harness must explicitly load them to execute them.

_Source: [0003-contribution.md](notes/0003-contribution.md)_


## GitHub administration

The live `main` protection requirement is tracked separately from the repository declaration. A configuration file alone does not protect a GitHub branch. Using a GitHub CLI login that has repository administration privileges, apply and verify the policy:

```bash
python3 .darkfactory/github/scripts/apply_branch_protection.py
python3 .darkfactory/github/scripts/apply_branch_protection.py --apply
```

The script reads `repo.dfconfig` and refuses unapproved replacement of existing divergent protection. Until GitHub reports `main.protected = true`, do not claim enforcement is complete. Native review settings may require an eligible reviewer other than the PR author.

_Source: [0004-administration.md](notes/0004-administration.md)_


## Single workspace and test suite

The physical source tree is `.darkfactory/`. Root `.agents` and `.github` are symbolic links, not separate directories. Project documents, role instructions and skills live at `.darkfactory/agents/`; GitHub workflow definitions and maintenance scripts live at `.darkfactory/github/`; **all tests** live under `.darkfactory/tests/`.

Run the test suite and documentation checks locally:

```bash
python3 -m unittest discover -s .darkfactory/tests -p 'test_*.py'
python3 .darkfactory/github/scripts/generate_documents.py --check
```

**GitHub Actions limitation:** A root `.github` symlink may not be followed by GitHub's workflow scanner. Workflow definitions remain source files but version-bump, CI and release automation cannot be assumed to operate. Verify native Actions execution before relying on those mechanisms or enforcing checks through branch protection.

_Source: [0005-darkfactory-structure.md](notes/0005-darkfactory-structure.md)_
